findings.passage: He says he believes voting rights “impact everything else that we’ve been discussing. When you talk about voting rights it’s not just the surface-level election day process. The whole concept of who governs is linked into access to voting. If I don’t have easy, consistent access to vote, then I don’t get to engage in the process of deciding who governs.
findings.note: Quoted by Hudson Valley Press in a profile of him as an incoming head of a national legislators' caucus group. He speaks of voting rights and access to voting in general; he does not mention ID or citizenship proof. The sentence copied is the writer's lead-in plus his quoted words; the page continues the quote past this point.
